content: कलापकम् .²1 A series of four stanzas on the same subject and forming one grammatical sentence (चतुर्भिस्तु कलापकम्); for an illustration see <ls>Ki. 3. 41</ls>, <ls n="Ki. 3.">42</ls>, <ls n="Ki. 3.">43</ls>, <ls n="Ki. 3.">44</ls>. .²2 A debt to be paid when the peacocks spread their tails. .{@-कः@} .²1 A band or bundle in general. .²2 A string of pearls; a kind of ornament; कलापकावक्षमाला यथेयम् <ls>Mb. 3. 112. 5</ls>. .²3 The rope round an elephantʼs neck. .²4 A zone or girdle (= कलाप); रशनाकलापकगुणेन वधूर्मकरध्वजद्विरदमाकलयत् <ls>Śi. 9. 45</ls>. .²5 A sectarian mark on the forehead (विशेषक).
